short_blurb: From remodels to ground-up builds — your Palmdale general contractor.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Palmdale. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Palmdale, including West Palmdale, East Palmdale, Rancho Vista, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Palmdale?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Palmdale building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Palmdale?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Palmdale rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Palmdale remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
